data.translation: Wenn der Reis gar wird, zur Hälfte seiner Garzeit, und die Milch kocht, schütten sie den Reis in die Milch und rühren ihn um, bis der Reis gar ist, also richtig gar ist.

data.turoyo: U ʕəraq, afandəm man apšoṯo kowe. An apšoṯo kmaḥtənne b gawe dab bəreməl rabe, kṭuranne yaman... mḥarkənne, mḥarkənne, mḥarkənne w mḥarkənne hul d nəfli mi quwwe.
data.translation: Arak, sir, comes from raisins. They put the raisins inside big barrels; they crush them well... They stir them, stir them, stir them and stir them until they lose their strength.

rationale: Raisin-mash material extension and fourfold repetition of agitation; selected for this process information despite the four round-1 examples.

data.turoyo: Ǧan: Kmo əšne hawxa grəšla? U zəbonano, hul d qayəmitu ʕal raġlayxun hawi? Aw an noše bdalle d miḥarki b Məḏyaḏ?
data.translation: Jan: How many years did it go on like that? The selling, until you could stand on your own feet, was that it? Or did people begin to move about in Midyat?

rationale: Thin Detransitive Infectum cell, explicit plural moving people and b-location rather than first-person immobility.
